name: Text Field
description: A framework-free Web Component that frames a native text input, wires its hint and error text, and reports validity after the person has actually typed.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: An outlined field with a static label above it and a line of supporting text below.

variants.name: Filled
variants.description: The filled surface treatment shown at both sizes beside the outlined one.

variants.name: Validation
variants.description: Required and typed fields that stay quiet until the person has interacted with them.

variants.name: Adorned
variants.description: Fields carrying a prefix, a suffix, and a password reveal button inside the frame.

variants.name: Multiline
variants.description: A textarea with a character counter that does not read itself out on every keystroke.

variants.name: Restricted
variants.description: Read-only beside disabled, showing which one still submits its value with the form.
